questions.q: The ball has travelled across to the other center back. Tap where the left fullback goes now.
options: Stay high where the carry ended
Drop back toward the back line
questions.explain: Right. With the ball gone across, the fullback drops back so the back line has no gap.
choiceExplanations: Staying high leaves a gap on the left while the ball is far away on the other side.
Pushing higher opens even more space behind, and the ball is not coming to that side.

questions.q: Put the move to the new side in order, from first to last.
options: Midfielder moves behind the left fullback
Fullback passes back to the midfielder
Right fullback receives on the other side
questions.explain: Yes. Support behind first, then the return, then the back line moves the ball to the new side.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Support behind first, then the return, then the back line moves the ball to the new side.
The fullback can only pass back once the midfielder is there to receive it.
The center backs switch it after the midfielder has played the ball back to them.
The right fullback receives last, after the whole back line has moved the ball across.

questions.q: The right fullback has carried much higher. You are the deeper midfielder. Where do you move to stay connected?
options: Deep in the middle, between the center backs
questions.explain: Yes. Behind and inside, you give a safe return pass and cover the space the fullback left.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Behind and inside, you give a safe return pass and cover the space the fullback left.
